About Smoking Spanners

VEHICLE REPAIRS WITH CARE.

Smoking Spanners is a mobile vehicle repair business focused on a convenient, approachable service. You can get in touch to discuss a problem, request a service or ask about a repair at a suitable location.

Contact us with your vehicle details and postcode to find out about available work and service areas.

Meet the Technician ↗

⚡ EV & Hybrid High-Voltage Diagnostics and Repair

Qualified in high-voltage diagnostics and repair for electric and hybrid vehicles, with practical experience working on EV and hybrid systems.

✓ MOT Testing

Qualified and experienced in MOT testing, with knowledge of vehicle inspections, roadworthiness and safety requirements.

Mobile inspections and repairs are not official MOT tests. Official MOT testing must take place at an authorised MOT testing station.

Tap the number to call.

Quick Enquiry

Subject to availability; not a confirmed booking.

Your details are used to prepare your enquiry. Nothing is sent until you choose WhatsApp or SMS and press Send. Please read our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

Call Now

Your name, vehicle registration, make/model, postcode or area, and service required are compulsory. Mileage, warning lights and preferred date are optional. WhatsApp and SMS open a draft; you must press Send yourself. A preferred date is a request, not a confirmed booking. Call Now doesn't need the form. This website does not store your details. Standard SMS charges may apply.

Good to know

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS.

Do you travel to customers?

Yes, Smoking Spanners offers mobile vehicle services. Please provide your postcode to confirm the service area and availability.

Can you help with warning lights?

Diagnostics are among the advertised services. Explain the warning light and symptoms when contacting us.

Can I get a quote?

Yes, send the vehicle details and work required. Some faults need inspection before a price can be confirmed.

Can I leave a review on the website?

Reviews are handled by Google and Facebook, rather than stored here. Use the links in the Reviews section to find the business.
